actions.title: PSA: Acme Cloud pricing change, what it actually means for self-hosters
actions.body:
Writing this up properly because the thread is full of half-information.

The 40% is aimed at the segment with the worst contracts and the best leverage, which is us. So here is what is actually true:

- Data export stays free forever. That is in the FAQ and it is the part that matters most for lock-in.
- The free tier cut from 3 projects to 1 and 5000 requests/hr to 1000 hits student and hobby projects hardest.
- Federation and on-prem are on the roadmap. Roadmap is not a contract.

StackHaven has a pinned migration thread and I am seeing a genuine spike in interest, not a raid. If you are leaving, leave with your data and leave loudly. Do not pretend the FAQ does not say what it says.
The delivered-versus-future split is the only part of this that will decide churn. Enterprise renews, the mid-market hesitates, the bottom of the market churns. Three reactions to one announcement.
